title_html: Decide shareholders, legal representative, registration liaison officer (登记联络员), and (if used) supervisor; prepare PRC ID cards and mobile numbers for real-name verification.

detail.html: If you appoint a supervisor, a director or senior manager cannot also serve as supervisor. Under the 2024 Company Law, many small LLCs may omit a supervisor by unanimous shareholder consent or use a board audit committee instead (Arts. 69 & 83). Designate a registration liaison officer with phone and email for AMR contact (mandatory since 2025-02-10).

title_html: Reserve 3–5 candidate names and secure a compliant registered address—lease + property certificate, or (where permitted) a government/business-park cluster address.

detail.html: Many cities run name checks inside the same “one-stop” website; the AMR must approve the final name before issuance. Cluster / centralized registration addresses vary by district—licensed or high-risk sectors may be barred; note any “集中登记地” label and term limits.

title_html: Set subscribed capital, shareholding ratios, payment timeline, and business scope (and any license-triggering lines).

detail.html: Under the 2024 Company Law, subscribed amounts must generally be fully paid within five years of incorporation unless transition rules apply—document the schedule in the articles.

title_html: File online through the provincial government service portal / enterprise “one-stop” (e.g. 开办企业一窗通)—upload IDs, address proof, generated articles, and e-sign with facial recognition.

detail.html: Optional: hire a local bookkeeping/agent firm (代办)—common for first-time founders; scope should list filing, chops, and tax onboarding. Many cities let you bundle seal carving, tax/digital invoicing, and social/housing fund registration in the same online application.

title_html: AMR review → receive the 营业执照 (electronic license immediate in many cities; paper optional).

detail.html: When materials are complete, many cities finish within one working day (some same-day) under enterprise “one-stop” flows—longer if the name, scope, or a pre-licence needs fixes.

title_html: Carve and file official seals (公章, 财务章, 法人章—invoice chop usually not needed under nationwide digital invoicing) with the public-security filing system.

detail.html: Some municipalities bundle free first seals for new market entrants (count and types vary by city)—check the same one-stop portal. Under nationwide 数电发票, digital invoices generally need no physical invoice seal.

title_html: Open the RMB basic bank account (基本户) with the license and seals—KYC is lighter than a WFOE but still in-person or video per bank policy.

detail.html: Shareholder capital can be wired from personal accounts per subscribed amounts—no foreign FDI account required. Wire within the five-year pay-in schedule, keep bank receipts and accounting vouchers; undocumented transfers may be treated as loans, not paid-in capital.

title_html: Complete new-taxpayer onboarding and enable fully digital e-invoices (数电票)—often linked through the one-stop flow after 多证合一.

detail.html: No separate tax registration certificate is issued—the unified social credit code on the license is shared with the tax bureau. Confirm tax categories and assign accounting rules (small-scale vs. general VAT taxpayer) with your agent before issuing invoices.

title_html: Register for social insurance and housing fund unit accounts before hiring—optional to bundle at setup.

detail.html: In many “one-stop” flows, social insurance and housing fund are optional at incorporation—you may defer until you hire. Contribution rates follow local rules—use the same city assumptions as the dashboard for planning.

title_html: Stand up bookkeeping and periodic tax filings (VAT—small-scale taxpayers usually quarterly; general taxpayers usually monthly; CIT prep; payroll withholding)—in-house or via a 代理记账 firm.

detail.html: Even with no revenue, file zero returns on schedule after licence issuance—missing deadlines triggers penalties and abnormal-listing risk. Budget this before you take your first paying client.
